g.text: Where Nepal's jobs are, and how many of them are highly exposed

text.style: font-size: 6.8px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #737373

g.text: Grey: share of all employed Nepalis in each group. Colour: the part of it in highly exposed occupations (ILO 2025).

text.style: font-size: 6.8px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; fill: #737373

g.text: Exposure = potential task overlap with current generative AI; not adoption, not job loss. NLSS-IV 2022/23, employment-weighted. Radius is proportional

text.style: font-size: 6.8px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; fill: #737373

g.text: to the square root of the share (rings at 2%, 5%, 10%, 20%). Armed forces and unknown occupations omitted.
